content: GitHub Copilot SDK is GA (semantic versioning), supports Python/TS/Go/.NET/Rust/Java. Client-server model: App -> SDK Client -> JSON-RPC -> Copilot CLI (server mode); SDK manages CLI lifecycle. Core concepts: create_session() with custom_agents, skill_directories, default_agent, tools; session.send_and_wait(); session.on() for lifecycle events. Custom agents = name+prompt (+ tools, mcp_servers, skills, description). Tool bounding via 3 layers: per-agent tools array (null=inherit all), session availableTools allowlist + excludedTools blocklist, defaultAgent.excludedTools orchestrator pattern. Read-only tools like grep/glob/view. MCP servers per-agent. Skills eagerly inject full content at startup.
